purpose: Define query joins exclusively over explicit declared relations or explicitly declared compatible join keys, preserving relation provenance and preventing heuristic joins.

topics.name: DWH Query Join
topics.purpose: Define query joins exclusively over explicit declared relations or explicitly declared compatible join keys, preserving relation provenance and preventing heuristic joins.

semantics.relation_rule: Preferred joins reference exact canonical relation identities.
semantics.key_rule: Explicit ad-hoc compatible-key joins, if permitted, declare exact left/right field refs and comparison semantics.
semantics.heuristic_rule: Matching names, values or positions never imply a join.
semantics.cardinality_rule: Join execution retains declared/observed cardinality evidence.
semantics.identity_rule: Joined result does not merge source record identities into one canonical source identity.
semantics.lineage_rule: Each output row/value retains contributing source lineage.
semantics.classification_rule: Joined output uses explicit classification join/propagation semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Authorization must cover applicable contributing source data.

invariants.rule: A DWH query is an explicit read/projection definition over exact resolved schema/instance/relation identities; querying, filtering, joining, aggregating, ordering or paginating never silently changes source ownership, identity or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: join inferred from matching field names
one-side read authority grants unrestricted access to other side

references.purpose: Relation joins use exact declared relations.
